title: Frequency membership prompts share one styled shell across Feed and public event chat
detail: Reproduced Feed's automatic Join the movement overlay and identified event chat's separate Join to chat modal implementation. Both now use one native JoinPrompt shell with the current glass/card/iridescent language, safe-area padding, short-screen scrolling/centering, accessible title/description, and body scroll lock. Shared CSS moved from member-shell to the already-root-loaded member UI sheet; old event-modal selectors removed. Feed retains30s/action gating and non-dismissibility; event retains Not now, browser Escape, guest RSVP, and event-specific login return. Focused mocked React tests prove these lifecycle/route distinctions. This does not establish that these are the user's exact two randomly appearing popups or prove simultaneous popup behavior; cookie/device permission semantics were not combined. Rendered final verification remains pending integrated localhost.

verify.evidence: Before: live390x844 Feed showed one automatic membership modal; event source independently used a different native Join to chat dialog.2 mocked integration tests pass: Feed timer/capture opens one modal and prevents Escape; event uses same class/shell, Not now and guestRSVP close it, login returns to event, body scroll restores. After integration: render both actual routes at320/390/light/dark, compare shell styling, verify focus trap/restoration through native dialog, Escape policy, scroll/safe-area and absence of stacked prompts. No account creation/RSVP/provider writes permitted during checks.
